Arkady Godlin I'm not sure what "meaning" you mean - but just so we are on the same page, I meant - that the Jewish need to stay a majority so we are not exterminated by an exponentially increasing non-Jewish population.  Having said that, yes, I'm fully aware that the religious Jews also have many more kids than the secular, just as the Muslims also have many more kids than the secular. Either way, our dream of equality gets squashed. 
Both need to be checked somehow. And I'm desperate to find a way forward. 
We must start with a government that won't support blindly funding and Torah students and their families and "exempting" them from service. This requires lots of nuance and compromise. I'm so inspired by the resolve of our Ethiopian, Indian, and Hebrew Israelite Jews who continue to serve and choose to raise their families here despite the discrimination they face. And that gives me a sense of hope that we could prevail in pursuit of true equality. I hope for a time when Filipino 18 year olds who were born and raised here could also serve in the army, as they choose to, even if they are born from illegal immigrants.
